name: claude-usage-bar
description: Live dashboard for Claude Code: plan limits (5h / 7d), tokens, subagents, token burners per task, and the Git + Power BI workflow you are working on. Reads data from the usage-band mod. by DELOT (v)

commands.title: Claude Code: Check for panel updates
Claude Code: Report an issue or idea about this panel
Claude Code: Open the panel project on GitHub

claudeUsageBar.userName.description: Name shown in the dashboard. Empty uses your global git user.name.

claudeUsageBar.pollIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) the status bar and panel refresh. Minimum 1000.

claudeUsageBar.notifications.description: Show a warning when a plan limit crosses a threshold.

claudeUsageBar.notifyAt.description: Usage percentages that trigger a notification.

claudeUsageBar.checkForUpdates.description: Once a day, ask GitHub whether a newer version of this panel exists and offer to install it. Only the public release list is requested; no usage data is sent.
